briefdescription.para: Finds the rigid transformation of source points to target points from given matches, many of which can be wrong: tests the transformations through random samples of three matches and keeps the one with most inliers, then refines it by least squares fitting on all its inliers.

parameterdescription.para: (source point, target point) pairs, e.g. from findFPFHMatches(...)
